name: ConversationGames
author: Jintaku
Kirin
short: Truth or dare, would you rather and never have I ever, with buttons and live votes.
description: Truth or dare, would you rather and never have I ever. Cards have buttons to keep the game going, would you rather and never have I ever count votes live, questions don't repeat until the deck runs out, and members can suggest questions for staff to approve.
install_msg: Get yo people grooving. Set a review channel with [p]cgset reviewchannel to take member suggestions.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store personal data. Votes are counted in memory while a card is live. Suggested questions are posted to the staff review channel with the suggesting member's mention; approved questions are stored without who suggested them.
